other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage: Encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes feature encodings (like frequency encoding) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks information about the test set distribution into the training data, leading to overly optimistic validation scores and potential overfitting.

other_failure_modes.name: Leaking ID column into model features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent excludes the 'id' column from the feature engineering list but fails to drop it from the training dataframe. Consequently, the ID column is passed directly to the model as a feature, which will cause the model to either crash (if ID is a string) or overfit to spurious patterns (if ID is numeric).

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation setup using CatBoost and performs reasonable categorical feature engineering. However, the solution suffers from a critical data leakage issue due to frequency encoding on the combined train/test dataset. Furthermore, the agent forgets to drop the 'id' column from the training data before fitting, which exposes the model to either crashing or severe overfitting.
